final_message:
Configured r1 as the DNS server for the four domains, with the requested host addresses and MX records. All 20 PCs now use it for name resolution. The existing links, addresses and routes are unchanged.

The startup scripts passed shell syntax checks. I could not run the lab or validate DNS responses because Kathara and the BIND validation tools are unavailable in this environment.

The MX records identify the requested mail hosts; they do not install or configure email delivery services.
